test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements (Assertion and Reason) carefully and select the most appropriate option with respect to them.

Assertion (A): Trees grow against gravity.

Reason (R): Nature defies gravitational law.

options.text: Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A.
Both A and R are false.
Both A and R are true but R is the correct explanation of A.
A is true but R is false.

solution:
• Assertion (A): Trees grow against gravity. - This is true because trees grow above the earth and upwards.
 
• Reason (R): Nature defies gravitational law. - This is false because nature follows the gravitational law.

Hence A is true but R is false.
